segments.normalizedSource: ```swift class MyObserver: NSObject { @objc var objectToObserve: MyObjectToObserve var observation: NSKeyValueObservation? init(object: MyObjectToObserve) { objectToObserve = object super.init() observation = observe( \.objectToObserve.myDate, options: [.old, .new] ) { object, change in print("myDate changed from: \(change.oldValue!), updated to: \(change.newValue!)") } } } ```
